$comment: SIFT hero venue registry: one entry per PHYSICAL venue. Read by src/lib/hero/resolve.ts.

tenants: the home teams that play there, per sport, with optional [from, to) ISO dates. A venue hosting several teams (MetLife: Giants and Jets; TD Garden: Bruins and Celtics; Hard Rock: Dolphins and Miami Hurricanes) lists each tenant; the hero always shows the ACTUAL home team's identity, never the building's other tenant.
A name may appear on more than one venue only when the game's date or the home team separates them (old/new Highmark Stadium; the many 'Memorial Stadium's).
kind 'neutral' venues have no tenants: they resolve from a published venue name only and always produce a neutral-site hero.
NBA tenants exist so shared arenas stay tenant-correct; Sift publishes no NBA game pages today.
Photos are NOT here: see src/lib/hero/photos.json (each photo names its venue AND the team whose identity it shows).
